headline: SILVER SPIKES 6.3% TO $85.50 — Trump Rejects Iran Deal, Hormuz Stays Shut, Sixth Straight Supply Deficit
snippet: Silver rocketed 6.3% to $85.50/oz on Monday — a two-month high — as President Trump dismissed Iran's peace proposal as 'totally unacceptable,' prolonging the Strait of Hormuz blockade and reigniting inflation fears. The move compounds a structural supply deficit now entering its sixth consecutive annual shortfall, with solar and AI data-center demand adding industrial urgency.

headline: BONANZA GRADE: Brixton Metals Hits 7,900 g/t Silver Peak Inside 13.0m at 594 g/t at Ontario's Langis Project
snippet: TSX-V silver explorer Brixton Metals (BBB.V) drilled 13.0m averaging 594 g/t silver at its Langis project in Ontario, including a 0.5m bonanza interval grading 7,900 g/t Ag. The result comes from a 68-hole, 13,845-metre 2026 program; the company says new mineralization remains to be found at what it calls 'a truly unique primary silver project.'

headline: THICK LITHIUM ZONE: Brunswick Exploration Drills 123m at 0.72% Li2O With 17.7m High-Grade Core at Anatacau Main
snippet: Quebec lithium explorer Brunswick Exploration (TSX-V: BRW) hit a 123-metre continuous package at 0.72% Li2O with a high-grade core of 17.7m at 1.10% Li2O at Anatacau Main — the fourth disclosed result from the 2026 winter campaign. Three more holes with additional pegmatite intersections are pending; almost all carry very high cesium values signalling multi-payable-mineral potential.

headline: Tocvan Ventures: 5,300m Drilled at Gran Pilar, El Mezquite Gold-Silver Discovery Confirmed, 50,000-Tonne Pilot Mine Plant Ordered
snippet: Tocvan Ventures (CVE:TOC) updated its fully funded 20,000-metre Gran Pilar drill program in Sonora, Mexico: 5,300m completed with 21 holes totalling 4,400m of results still pending. The El Mezquite gold-silver discovery is being followed up with a diamond core rig for structural data, while the company has already ordered processing equipment for its fully permitted 50,000-tonne pilot mine facility.

headline: Gold Stock Weakness Masks RECORD Producer Cash Flows — AISC Spreads Above $3,000/oz Signal M&A Window Opening
snippet: Analyst John Feneck argues that surface-level gold equity weakness is masking a generational earnings story: with Agnico Eagle printing a realized gold price of $4,861/oz against AISC of $1,483, the $3,234/oz margin spread is producing free cash flow at a pace that gives majors balance-sheet firepower to acquire juniors with quality ounces in the ground.

headline: NexGen Energy PCE Uranium: 13.0m at 5.2% U3O8 Confirms High-Grade Zone Expansion — 42,000m Summer Drill Starts May 25
snippet: NexGen Energy's final 2025 winter assays from the Patterson Corridor East discovery returned 13.0m at 5.2% U3O8 — including 0.5m at 30.2% — at 400m depth, alongside 10.0m at 3.95% U3O8 at 670m. The results confirm ongoing high-grade expansion 3.5km from the Arrow deposit; a 42,000-metre summer program restarts the week of May 25.

headline: Fredonia Mining Locks Up 33,500 ha of Argentina's Deseado Massif With Pan American Silver Property Deal
snippet: TSX-V junior Fredonia Mining (FRED.V) acquired 11,754 ha of contiguous ground from a Pan American Silver subsidiary, expanding its El Dorado–Monserrat district to 33,500 ha — a 50%+ increase. The deal ties together two previously separated mineralized corridors adjacent to AngloGold Ashanti's Cerro Vanguardia mine in Santa Cruz, Argentina.

headline: NdPr SLIDES 21% in April to $99.61/kg — Sharp Post-Rally Correction or Structural Reversal for Rare Earth Magnets?
snippet: NdPr oxide fell 21% in April to $99.61/kg — the sharpest monthly decline since Q1's rally — pulling neodymium oxide to $108.96/kg and praseodymium oxide to $109.60/kg. Analysts cite profit-taking and downstream inventory drawdown; NdPr is still up 88% year-to-date and Western buyers are not yet panicking, with CIF Rotterdam unchanged at $255/kg.

headline: Can USA Rare Earth's $2.8B Brazil Bet Actually Dent China's 90% Stranglehold on Rare Earth Refining?
snippet: The Diplomat unpacks whether USA Rare Earth's $2.8B acquisition of Serra Verde — the only large-scale producer of all four magnetic rare earths outside Asia — can realistically challenge China's 90% grip on global refining. A Brazilian Supreme Court challenge filed April 25 by political party Rede Sustentabilidade adds legal jeopardy to an already complex geopolitical deal.

headline: CHILE SPLIT: Lithium Exports SURGE 175% in April as SQM-Codelco Ramps; Copper Stalls on Demand Concerns
snippet: Chile's April export data shows lithium carbonate receipts of $498 million (+175.6%), with Q1 lithium carbonate delivering $1.1 billion (+147.7% YoY) as the SQM-Codelco partnership ramps production. Copper exports stalled in the same period — a telling divergence given LME copper is trading near $13,000/tonne on tariff-driven US demand pull.

headline: COT Report: Gold & Silver Speculator Longs Stay Extended — Producers Trade at 10% Discount to 2026 Spot EBITDA
snippet: GoldSeek's May 8 Commitment of Traders breakdown shows speculator net-long positioning in gold and silver remaining elevated, even as gold producers trade at 10% discount on 2026E EV/EBITDA versus consensus and a 44% discount using spot prices — creating a setup analysts call one of the widest valuation gaps since the 2016 bull run began.
